customManagers.description: Tool versions pinned in workflow env vars, tagged with a `# renovate:` annotation, optionally followed by `@sha256:` and the image digest. Actions and setup-* inputs are found by the built-in manager; a version in a `docker run` line is not.

packageRules.description: Automerge minor and patch updates once they are seven days old

yggdrasil's modules, pinned by SHA with the version beside it. A patch or minor release merges itself once it is three days old, the wait every repo that calls them uses (yggdrasil decision record 0023), instead of the seven days above.

Bluebird Forecast's image tag and chart version are written by its own release jobs, after its CI and release checks pass. A Renovate update would move them on Validate manifests alone, so Renovate leaves them to those jobs.

hevy-garmin-sync's chart version is written by its own release job, once its tests and image scans pass. Its version tag reaches GHCR before those scans, so a Renovate update could move to a release the scan stopped. Renovate leaves it to that job.

Personal-Website's and Mountaineers-Activity-Scraper's image tags are written by their own release jobs, once each image scan passes, for the same reason as hevy-garmin-sync's. Renovate leaves them to those jobs.
llama.cpp tags its CPU image light-b<build>, alongside tags for other variants. Only follow this one, and treat each build as a patch.
